scientific_interpretation: C4K does not support the claim that current (H,Wb,Wt) state is insufficient because of direction/history ambiguity in this A2 laboratory.
RISE and FALL occupy substantially separated regions of reduced-state space; the current state already carries regime information rather than presenting widespread near-collisions.

Cross-direction terminal and adjacent secant slopes differ strongly, but the preregistered curvature ambiguity criterion fails for both widths. Curvature differences are smaller than matched within-direction controls for most pairs.
This is not proof of universal memoryless sufficiency. It only removes the present evidence basis for adding a memory state before another existing-state gradient representation is tested.
